messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Constructive geometric design based on affine-regular point lattices or sublattices

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration for maximizing the minimum triangle area is the affine image of the regular triangular lattice sublattice with coordinates (i + 2j mod 5, j) for i in {0,1,2} and j in {0,1,2,3}, scaled to fit within [0,1]x[0,1]. This configuration achieves a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/12, determined by the smallest fundamental parallelogram half-areas of the underlying triangular lattice. No 13-point configuration in the unit square can achieve a larger minimum triangle area, as the triangular lattice provides the densest packing of equilateral-affine cells."}
